label: Tavily
description: Web search and page extraction for agents
agentGuide: POST /search with a JSON body {"query": "...", "max_results": 5, "search_depth": "basic", "include_answer": true} (also topic: "news", days: 7, include_domains: [...]). The answer field is a short synthesis, results[] carry url, title, content, score. Read whole pages: POST /extract {"urls": ["https://..."]} gives results[].raw_content. Crawl a site: POST /crawl {"url": "https://...", "max_depth": 1}. Each call spends credits: one good query beats many. Cite the urls you use.
